Asset type: transparent chibi character welcome illustration for Umeko Desktop.
Create Tiara Basori / 馬剃天愛星 from Makeine. Image 1 is the official identity and costume reference. Image 2 is ONLY the application's illustration style reference; do not borrow its character identity.
Tiara has neatly pulled-back dark blue-black hair with short separated bangs, a compact low bun at the back, short side locks, gray-blue eyes, pale skin, and a slightly earnest composed expression. Preserve her light gray school blazer with dark navy piping, white blouse with a vertical stack of pale blue bow ribbons, gray pleated skirt if visible. Small chest badge must be blank, no writing.
Draw a polished cute chibi upper body with a large expressive face, complete head/hair and both hands. Three-quarter very slight turn toward viewer, gently smiling with a modest blush, one open hand raised in a polite welcoming wave, other arm holding a small navy clipboard against her chest.
Style: clean crisp pixel-edged anime cel shading matching image 2, confident fine dark contours, restrained highlights, readable at small UI size, no 3D, no painterly texture.
Composition: one centered figure, square canvas, all hair, hands and clipboard inside frame with about 5% clear margin. Bottom is a clean waist-up crop. Truly transparent background, no scenery, no ground, no text, logo, watermark, frame or circular badge.
